name: AP-1 (FOS/JUN)
def: TRE/AP-1 site TGA(C/G)TCA. FOS, FOSB, FOSL1/2, JUN, JUNB, JUND, BATF, BATF2/3, JDP2, ATF3, and FOS::JUN heterodimers.

name: CREB / ATF (CRE)
def: Cyclic-AMP response element TGACGTCA and its half-site. CREB1, CREM, ATF1, ATF2, ATF4, ATF7, CREB5.

name: ATF6 / CREB3 (ER stress)
def: ERSE / UPR elements, TGACGTGG-like. ATF6, ATF6B, CREB3, CREB3L1-L4, XBP1.

name: C/EBP
def: TT(G/A)CGCAA palindrome. CEBPA/B/D/E/G, and DDIT3 (CHOP) heterodimer sites.

name: MAF (MARE)
def: Maf recognition element TGCTGAC(G)TCAGCA; large MAFs (MAF, MAFA/B, NRL) and small MAFs (MAFF/G/K).

name: NFE2 / NRF / BACH (ARE)
def: Antioxidant/electrophile response element TGACTCAGC. NFE2, NFE2L1/L2/L3, BACH1, BACH2.

name: PAR bZIP (HLF/NFIL3/DBP)
def: Proline- and acidic-rich bZIPs binding TTATG(T/C)AA. HLF, NFIL3/E4BP4, DBP, TEF.

name: Other bZIP
def: bZIP factors not covered above, e.g. CREBZF, CREBL2, and unclassified bZIP archetypes.

name: MYC / MAX / MXD
def: Canonical E-box CACGTG. MYC, MYCN, MAX, MXI1, MXD1-4, MNT, MGA, MLX, MLXIP, MLXIPL.

name: USF
def: E-box with flanking preference GTCACGTGAC. USF1, USF2, USF3.

name: MITF / TFE (CLEAR)
def: CLEAR/M-box GTCACGTGAC. MITF, TFE3, TFEB, TFEC.

name: SREBP
def: Sterol response element TCACNCCAC plus E-box binding. SREBF1, SREBF2.

name: CLOCK / BMAL1
def: Tandem E-boxes CACGTG of the circadian oscillator. CLOCK, ARNTL/BMAL1, NPAS2.

name: HIF / ARNT
def: Hypoxia response element (A/G)CGTG. HIF1A, EPAS1/HIF2A, HIF3A, ARNT, ARNT2.

name: AHR / AHRR
def: Xenobiotic response element TNGCGTG. AHR, AHRR (with ARNT).

name: NPAS3 / NPAS4 / other PAS
def: Neuronal PAS-domain bHLH factors binding E-box variants.

name: E-proteins (TCF3/4/12)
def: Class I bHLH E-box CAGCTG/CACCTG heterodimer partners. TCF3/E2A, TCF4/ITF2, TCF12/HEB, TCF15, TCFL5.

name: Myogenic bHLH (MyoD)
def: Muscle E-box CAGCTG with AT-flank preference. MYOD1, MYF5, MYF6, MYOG, MSC, MYOR.

name: NeuroD / Atonal / ASCL
def: Class II neural E-box CAGATG / CAGCTG. NEUROD1/2/4/6, NEUROG1-3, ATOH1/7/8, ASCL1/2, OLIG1-3, PTF1A, FERD3L, BHLHA9/15, BHLHE22/23, MSGN1, FIGLA, NHLH1/2.

name: TWIST / HAND
def: E-box CATCTG/CAGATG bound by TWIST1/2, HAND1/2, TCF21, MESP1/2, SCX.

name: TAL1 / LYL1 (hematopoietic)
def: E-box CAGCTG/CAGGTG within composite GATA-E-box elements. TAL1, TAL2, LYL1.

name: HES / HEY (N-box)
def: Class C bHLH-Orange repressors reading CACGYG (and the N box CACNAG); the CACGTG form is shared with the MYC/USF/MITF/CLOCK E-box families. HES1-7, HEY1/2, HEYL, HELT.

name: BHLHE40 / BHLHE41 (DEC1/2)
def: Class B E-box CACGTG repressors of the circadian and hypoxia programs.

name: TFAP4 (AP-4)
def: Palindromic E-box CAGCTG. TFAP4.

name: EBF / COE
def: Palindromic Olf-1/EBF site TCCCNNGGGA, read by a Rel-like DNA-binding domain with a zinc knuckle rather than by a bHLH. EBF1-4 (COE1-3).

name: Other bHLH
def: bHLH factors and archetypes not covered above, incl. MYRF-like and unclassified E-box archetypes.

name: Steroid receptors (GR/MR/PR/AR)
def: Inverted repeat of AGAACA (ARE/GRE) spaced by 3 bp. NR3C1/GR, NR3C2/MR, PGR, AR.

name: Estrogen receptors
def: ERE: inverted AGGTCA repeat, GGTCAnnnTGACC. ESR1, ESR2.

name: Estrogen-related receptors
def: ERRE TNAAGGTCA extended half-site. ESRRA, ESRRB, ESRRG.

name: RXR and its heterodimers
def: DR1-DR5 direct repeats of AGGTCA. RXRA/B/G, RARA/B/G, THRA/THRB, VDR, PPARA/D/G, NR1H2/3 (LXR), NR1H4 (FXR), NR1I2/I3 (PXR/CAR).

name: NR4A (NUR77/NURR1)
def: NBRE AAAGGTCA monomeric half-site and NurRE. NR4A1/2/3.

name: NR5A (SF-1 / LRH-1)
def: SF-1 response element (T)CAAGGTCA. NR5A1, NR5A2.

name: ROR
def: RORE: AT-rich half-site AAAGTAGGTCA. RORA, RORB, RORC.

name: REV-ERB (NR1D)
def: RevDR2 and RORE-like sites. NR1D1, NR1D2.

name: COUP-TF (NR2F)
def: DR1 AGGTCAAAGGTCA. NR2F1/2/6.

name: HNF4
def: DR1 with strong 5' extension. HNF4A, HNF4G, NR2C1/2 (TR2/TR4).

name: NR2E (TLX / PNR)
def: AAGGTCA monomeric sites. NR2E1, NR2E3.

name: NR6A1 (GCNF)
def: DR0 direct repeat TCAAGGTCA. NR6A1.

name: Other nuclear receptors
def: Nuclear receptor archetypes and orphan receptors not covered above.

name: ETS class I (ETS1/ERG/FLI1)
def: GGA(A/T) core, ACCGGAAGT. ETS1/2, ERG, FLI1, FEV, ETV1/4/5, ETV6/7, ERF, ETV3, ELK1/3/4, GABPA, SPDEF.

name: ETS epithelial (ELF/EHF)
def: AACCGGAAGT with distinct 5' preference. ELF1-5, EHF, ELF2.

name: SPI1 / SPIB / SPIC (PU.1)
def: Purine-rich AGAGGAAGTG. SPI1, SPIB, SPIC; EICE composite with IRF.

name: ETV2 / ETV6-type
def: ETS sites with tandem GGAA repeats favoured by ETV2 and the ETV6 repressor.

name: IRF
def: ISRE/AICE, AANTGAAA repeats. IRF1-9; composite EICE (with SPI1) and AICE (with BATF).

name: STAT
def: GAS TTCnnnGAA and ISRE-like. STAT1-4, STAT5A/B, STAT6.

name: NF-kB / Rel
def: kB site GGGRNNYYCC. NFKB1, NFKB2, RELA, RELB, REL.

name: NFAT
def: GGAAA core; NFATC1-4 (Rel-homology) and NFAT5/TonEBP.

name: p53 family
def: Two decamers RRRCWWGYYY. TP53, TP63, TP73.

name: RUNX
def: TGTGGT core (ACCACA). RUNX1/2/3 with CBFB.

name: MEF2
def: AT-rich CTA(A/T)4TAG. MEF2A/B/C/D.

name: SRF
def: CArG box CCW6GG. SRF.

name: T-box
def: AGGTGTGA half-site, palindromic in TBXT. TBX1-6, TBX10, TBX15, TBX18-21, TBXT/T, TBR1, EOMES, MGA.

name: GATA
def: WGATAA. GATA1-6, TRPS1; composite GATA-E-box with TAL1.

name: RFX
def: X-box GTTRCC(A/T)3GGYAAC. RFX1-8.

name: SMAD
def: SBE GTCT/AGAC and GC-rich SMAD motifs. SMAD1-5, SMAD9.

name: NFI (CTF/NF-1)
def: Palindromic TTGGC(N5)GCCAA. NFIA, NFIB, NFIC, NFIX.

name: AP-2 (TFAP2)
def: GCCYGCRGGC. TFAP2A-E.

name: Grainyhead (GRHL)
def: AACCGGTT. GRHL1-3, TFCP2, TFCP2L1, UBP1.

name: TEAD
def: MCAT element GGAATG. TEAD1-4.

name: NF-Y (CBF)
def: CCAAT box. NFYA, NFYB, NFYC.

name: HSF
def: Heat-shock element, inverted nGAAn repeats. HSF1/2/4/5, HSFY1/2.

name: SAND domain (AIRE/SP100/GMEB)
def: GMEB1/2 (GRE-modulating), SP100, SP140, AIRE, DEAF1-like SAND factors.

name: MYB / MYB-like
def: MBS YAACKG. MYB, MYBL1, MYBL2; plus Myb/SANT archetypes (SNAPC4, MYPOP, TERF1/2 telobox).

name: E2F / DP
def: TTTSSCGC. E2F1-8, TFDP1/2.

name: CSL / RBPJ
def: GTGGGAA. RBPJ (SUH), plus NOTCH-dependent dimer sites.

name: DMRT (DM domain)
def: DM element, palindromic ACAWTGTW. DMRT1-3, DMRTA1/2, DMRTB1, DMRTC2.

name: Ndt80/PhoG-like (C11orf9/MYRF)
def: Ndt80-like DNA-binding domain archetypes, incl. MYRF.

name: THAP-type zinc finger
def: THAP1, THAP12 and other THAP-type zinc fingers. THAP11 is covered by the ZNF143 entry, whose site it shares.

name: BED-type zinc finger
def: hAT-transposase-derived BED fingers. ZBED1 (hDREF, TATCGATA), ZBED2/4/5.

name: CENP-B / pogo / Tigger
def: CENP-B box TTCGTTGGAA and related pogo-family transposase-derived domains. CENPB, TIGD1-7, POGK, JRK, CENPBD1.

name: ARID / BRIGHT
def: AT-rich interaction domain; ARID3A/B, ARID5A/B.

name: MBD and CxxC readers
def: Methyl-CpG and unmethylated-CpG readers. MECP2, MBD1-3, CXXC1/4/5, KDM2A/B, TET1/3, DNMT1, KMT2A/B.

name: HMGA (AT-hook)
def: AT-rich minor-groove binding. HMGA1, HMGA2.

name: Cold-shock domain (YBX)
def: Y-box CTGATTGGC. YBX1 and CSD archetypes.

name: TBP / TATA
def: TATA box TATAWAWR. TBP, TAF1.

name: PROX1 (Prospero)
def: Prospero-domain homeodomain-like factor PROX1.

name: Other / unclassified
def: Motifs whose factor has no assigned structural family here: LCOR and LCORL (psq-type HTH) and LRRFIP1. Cofactors without a DBD are in CHROMATIN; unnamed archetypes are in ZNF_UNNAMED.

name: Anterior HOX (HOX1-8)
def: TAAT core with PBX/MEIS cooperativity; paralogue groups 1-8: HOXA1-A7, HOXB1-B8, HOXC4-C8, HOXD1-D8.

name: Posterior HOX (HOX9-13, AbdB-like)
def: TTTTATKR / TTAT core preferred by paralogue groups 9-13: HOXA9-A13, HOXB9, HOXB13, HOXC9-C13, HOXD9-D13.

name: NKX
def: TAAGTG / CACTTAA. NKX1-1/1-2, NKX2-1 to 2-8, NKX3-1/3-2, NKX6-1 to 6-3, plus NKX-like archetypes.

name: Q50 homeodomain (DLX/MSX/LHX-type, TAATTA)
def: Palindromic TAATTA read by homeodomains with glutamine at position 50, grouped by that specificity rather than by gene family: DLX1-6, MSX1-3, LHX1-9, ALX1/3/4, PRRX1/2, SHOX/SHOX2, EMX1/2, VAX1/2, EN1/2, GBX1/2, BARHL1/2, BARX1/2, UNCX, ARX, ESX1, HLX, HMX1-3, MEOX1/2, MNX1, NOTO, HESX1, ISL1/2, ISX, LBX1/2, LMX1A/1B, DBX1/2, EVX1/2, GSX1/2, TLX1-3, and the Q50 paired-like factors VSX1/2, RAX/RAX2, PHOX2A/2B, NOBOX, MIXL1, VENTX, PROP1, DRGX, BSX, OTP, SEBOX, PDX1.

name: K50 homeodomain (OTX/PITX/CRX-type, TAATCC)
def: TAATCC/TAATCY specificity from lysine at homeodomain position 50. The true K50 set: OTX1/2, CRX, DMBX1, PITX1-3, GSC, GSC2. Paired-like factors that carry Q50 and read TAATTA are grouped with HD_Q50 instead, whatever their gene family.

name: PRD-like / primate-specific (CRX-like)
def: Divergent paired-like homeodomains of germline and early embryo: DPRX, LEUTX, TPRX1, ARGFX, RHOXF1/2, DUX-like TPRX paralogs.

name: DUX / DUXA
def: Double homeodomain TAATCTAATCA. DUX4, DUXA, DUXB.

name: TALE homeodomain (PBX/MEIS/TGIF)
def: TGATTGAT and TGACAG. PBX1-4, MEIS1-3, PKNOX1/2, TGIF1/2, TGIF2LX/2LY; PBX-HOX composite sites.

name: CUX (CUT homeodomain)
def: ATCGAT / ATCRAT. CUX1, CUX2, SATB1, SATB2.

name: ONECUT (HNF6)
def: TATTGATTT. ONECUT1/2/3.

name: POU (octamer)
def: Octamer ATGCAAAT and MORE/PORE dimer sites. POU1F1, POU2F1-3, POU3F1-4, POU4F1-3, POU5F1/OCT4, POU5F1B, POU6F1/2.

name: HNF1
def: GTTAATNATTAAC palindrome. HNF1A, HNF1B.

name: SIX
def: MEF3 element, read as TGATAC / GTATCA (the two strands of one extended site). SIX1/2/4 and SIX3/6 select the same core in vitro and differ in cofactor use rather than in sequence.

name: IRX (TALE, Iroquois)
def: ACA-rich TALE sites. IRX1-6.

name: CDX / PDX / anterior gut HD
def: TTTATG / CTTTAT. CDX1/2/4, PDX1, and related ParaHox factors.

name: Atypical / composite homeodomain
def: Homeodomains in unusual architectures: ZHX1-3, ZFHX2/3, HOMEZ, TSHZ1-3, ADNP, HDX, HMBOX1, PROX1-like, HHEX, POU-less HD archetypes.

name: PAX paired domain
def: Paired-domain site GTCACGC(A/T)TGA; PAX1/9, PAX2/5/8, PAX3/7, PAX4/6 (with and without the homeodomain half-site).

name: Forkhead (FOX)
def: RYAAAYA core. FOXA1-3, FOXB1/2, FOXC1/2, FOXD1-4, FOXE1, FOXF1/2, FOXG1, FOXH1, FOXI1, FOXJ1-3, FOXK1/2, FOXL1/2, FOXM1, FOXN1-4, FOXO1/3/4/6, FOXP1-4, FOXQ1, FOXR1/2, FOXS1.

name: Divergent forkhead sites (FOXP dimeric / FHL)
def: Forkhead factors whose preferred site is not the canonical RYAAAYA: FOXP1-4 dimeric TGTTTAC repeats, and the alternate FHL/GACGC site used by FOXN1/N4 and bispecifically by FOXN2/N3, FOXJ2/J3.

name: SOX (HMG box)
def: AACAAT / (A/T)(A/T)CAA(A/T)G. SOX1-21, SOX30, SRY; plus SOX-OCT composite sites.

name: TCF/LEF (HMG box)
def: WNT response element CTTTGWW. TCF7, TCF7L1, TCF7L2, LEF1.

name: Other HMG-box
def: HMG-box factors outside SOX and TCF/LEF: HMG20A/20B, BBX, HMGB-like archetypes.

name: CTCF
def: 19-bp core CCASYAGRKGGCRSYR with upstream module; the insulator/loop-anchor motif. CTCF.

name: CTCFL (BORIS)
def: CTCF-like core bound by the testis paralogue CTCFL.

name: KLF / SP (GC-box)
def: GC-box GGGGCGGGG and CACCC-box. KLF1-17, SP1-9.

name: EGR
def: GCGTGGGCG. EGR1-4, WT1.

name: WT1
def: EGR-like GC-rich site with distinct KTS-isoform preference. WT1.

name: GLI
def: GACCACCCA. GLI1-3, GLI4, GLIS1-3, ZIC-adjacent sites.

name: ZIC
def: GLI-like CCTGCTGNG. ZIC1-5.

name: ZEB
def: E-box-like CACCTG bound by ZEB1/ZEB2 zinc fingers.

name: SNAIL / SCRATCH
def: E-box CAGGTG. SNAI1-3, SCRT1/2.

name: GFI1 / GFI1B
def: AATC core, TAAATCAC(A/T)GC. GFI1, GFI1B.

name: INSM1 / INSM2
def: INSM1 and INSM2. The matrices here are GC-rich (TGTCAGGGGGCG) rather than E-box-like, and all three trace back to one compiled model, so the apparent agreement between databases is one matrix repeated.

name: YY1 / YY2
def: AAnATGGCggc. YY1, YY2, ZFP42/REX1.

name: REST (NRSF)
def: 21-bp RE1/NRSE TTCAGCACCACGGACAGCGCC. REST.

name: ZNF143 / THAP11 (SBS)
def: SPH/SBS element ACTACAATTCCC, bound by ZNF143 and by THAP11 (Ronin) with HCFC1; also ZNF76.

name: ZNF263
def: Long GA-rich/GGAGGA repeat motif. ZNF263.

name: MAZ / PATZ1
def: GGGAGGG G-rich sites. MAZ, PATZ1, ZNF278-like.

name: ZBTB33 (Kaiso)
def: KBS TCCTGCNA and methyl-CpG CGCG sites. ZBTB33.

name: ZBTB7A/B/C (LRF)
def: GC-rich GACCCCCCCC. ZBTB7A, ZBTB7B, ZBTB7C.

name: ZBTB18 (RP58)
def: ZBTB18 (RP58): a C2H2 repressor reading the E-box-like site MACATCTGKM, core CATCTG/CAGATG - an E-box read by zinc fingers rather than by a bHLH.

name: Other BTB-ZF (ZBTB)
def: BTB-domain zinc fingers without a dedicated entry: ZBTB1-6, ZBTB11-49 and relatives. BCL6/BCL6B, HIC1/HIC2, ZBTB17, ZBTB18, ZBTB33, ZBTB7A/B/C and ZBTB48 are covered separately.

name: BCL6 / BCL6B
def: STAT-like TTCCTAGAA bound by the BTB-ZF repressors BCL6, BCL6B.

name: HIC1 / HIC2
def: TGCC(A/G) HiRE sites. HIC1, HIC2.

name: ZBTB17 (MIZ1)
def: Core-promoter GC-rich MIZ1 sites; MYC partner. ZBTB17.

name: IKZF (Ikaros)
def: GGGAA core Ikaros sites. IKZF1-5.

name: BCL11A / BCL11B
def: TGACCA-containing sites. BCL11A, BCL11B.

name: PRDM
def: PR/SET-domain zinc fingers. PRDM1/BLIMP1 (AAAG(T/C)GAAAG), PRDM4-6, PRDM9 (recombination hotspots), PRDM10/13/14/15/16.

name: MECOM / EVI1
def: Two-finger-cluster GATA-like and GACAAGATA sites. MECOM, PRDM16-EVI1 module.

name: SALL
def: AT-rich double zinc-finger sites. SALL1-4.

name: ZFX / ZFY
def: CpG-island GGCCT core at promoters. ZFX, ZFY.

name: ZNF384 / ZNF362
def: AT-rich TAAAAA-type site at extracellular-matrix gene promoters, shared by the near-identical paralogues ZNF384 and ZNF362.

name: ZNF410
def: Long GC-rich site clustered at the CHD4 promoter. ZNF410.

name: ZNF460 / ZNF317-like
def: Long composite KZFP motifs characterised by ChIP-exo; covers ZNF460 and the closely related ZNF317.

name: ZNF768
def: MYC-box-like TGGCAGCAGC repeat. ZNF768.

name: ZNF281 / ZNF148 (ZBP-89)
def: GC-rich CCCCACCCC sites. ZNF281, ZNF148, ZNF219.

name: ZNF24 / ZSCAN-type promoter ZFs
def: SCAN-domain zinc fingers with defined promoter motifs. ZNF24, ZSCAN4, ZKSCAN1/3, ZSCAN21/22/29.

name: HINFP (MIZF)
def: Histone H4 promoter site GTCCGCGGTA. HINFP.

name: MTF1
def: Metal response element TGCRCNC. MTF1.

name: VEZF1
def: CT/GC-rich sites in vascular promoters. VEZF1.

name: RREB1
def: RAS-responsive element, GC-rich. RREB1.

name: MYT1 / ST18 (CCHC zinc finger)
def: AAAGTTT core neural repressor sites. MYT1, MYT1L, ST18.

name: KRAB zinc-finger proteins (KZFPs)
def: The large, rapidly evolving KRAB-ZNF family; long idiosyncratic motifs, frequently derived from transposable elements. Most ZNF### genes without a separate entry.

name: Other C2H2 zinc fingers
def: C2H2 factors and archetypes that are not KZFPs and have no dedicated entry.

name: SCAN-domain zinc fingers (ZSCAN/ZKSCAN)
def: SCAN-domain C2H2 factors: ZSCAN and ZKSCAN genes, ZNF24-like SCAN factors.

name: GTF3A (TFIIIA)
def: 5S rRNA internal control region. GTF3A.

name: Transposase-derived / TE-binding zinc fingers
def: Zinc fingers whose motif is a transposable-element sequence (ZNF91/93 on SVA/L1, ZNF445, ZFP57 on imprinted TGCCGC, ZNF808, ZNF780A).

name: ZFP57 / imprinting
def: Methylated TGCCGC hexamer at imprinting control regions. ZFP57, ZNF445.

name: NRF1
def: Palindromic GCGCATGCGC at nuclear-encoded mitochondrial gene promoters. NRF1.

name: GCM (glial cells missing)
def: GCM box ATGCGGGT. GCM1, GCM2.

name: PLAG / PLAGL
def: GRGGC(N6-8)GGG bipartite sites. PLAG1, PLAGL1/ZAC1, PLAGL2.

name: OVOL (OVO-like)
def: CCGTTA core. OVOL1, OVOL2, OVOL3.

name: CASZ1 (castor)
def: Castor-type multi-zinc-finger factor; AT-rich composite site. CASZ1.

name: CAMTA
def: CGCG box bound by the calmodulin-binding CG-1 domain. CMTA1/CAMTA1, CAMTA2.

name: OSR1 / OSR2
def: Odd-skipped related zinc fingers; GC-rich sites. OSR1, OSR2.

name: CIC (capicua)
def: HMG-box repressor binding TGAATGAA octamer. CIC.

name: HBP1
def: HMG-box factor binding an AT-rich site at cell-cycle promoters. HBP1.

name: PURA / PURB
def: PUR-repeat GGN-rich single-strand-capable binders. PURA, PURB.

name: LIN54 / DREAM (CHR)
def: Cell-cycle genes homology region TTYGAA. LIN54 in the DREAM/LIN complex.

name: CDC5L
def: Myb-like repeat factor with a spliceosomal role; MBS-like site. CDC5L.

name: Telobox (TERF1/TERF2/ZBTB48)
def: Telomeric TTAGGG repeat binders. TERF1, TERF2, ZBTB48/TZAP.

name: RNA-binding proteins with inferred DNA motifs
def: Factors whose motif comes from an RNA-binding assay or from inference, so the DNA motif should be read with caution: CPEB1, LIN28B and MBNL2. MBNL1 has no matrix in these databases.

name: Chromatin regulators without a classical DBD
def: Motifs attributed to cofactors, readers and writers that have no sequence-specific DBD of their own: BPTF, PHF1, PHF21A, DPF1/2, MYSM1, SETBP1, TOPORS, GATAD2A, ZFPM1, ZZZ3, GLYR1, TCF20, SP140L, NAIF1, ARID1A.

name: Thinly characterized small families
def: Factors with a measured motif but almost no dedicated literature: MSANTD1/3/4, DNTTIP1, FLYWCH1, FAM200B (= ZBED11), ELYS/AHCTF1, NACC2, and XPA, which is a DNA repair protein rather than a transcription factor. BANP is named in older drafts of this entry, but its only matrix is a joint Vierstra archetype filed under ZBTB_OTHER.

name: Other Rel-homology archetypes
def: Rel-homology-region archetypes that cannot be assigned to NF-kB or NFAT.

name: SPZ1
def: Testis-specific bHLH-Zip factor. SPZ1.

name: AP-2-like archetypes
def: AP-2-family archetypes without a specific TFAP2 paralogue assignment.

name: Fusion oncoprotein motifs
def: Motifs from fusion proteins, e.g. EWSR1-FLI1 GGAA microsatellite binding.

name: DACH / SKI-family corepressors
def: DACH1/DACH2 (DD1 winged-helix, binds forkhead-like sites and competes with FOXM1) and the SKI/SnoN/SKOR corepressors (SKI, SKIL, SKOR1, SKOR2), whose DNA contact comes from a SAND-like motif in the Ski homology domain. Their ChIP motifs often resemble those of the homeodomain partners they are recruited by.

name: Unnamed zinc-finger archetypes
def: Archetype motifs whose only label is the generic token ZNF, so nothing is claimed beyond the structural class. This is not one motif: it is a set of long, distinct zinc-finger matrices, many of them matching transposable-element sequence.
